items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Yank was playing, Orlenfeld was there when I came here, when we had our band.

ctx.x: How long was Buddy Johnson around? Was he still playing when you started across the river? Sure he was playing. He was still there then.
Yank was playing, Orlenfeld was there when I came here, when we had our band.
I never knew any of them, I don't even know when they died or how long they were here.
